summary: Frontend-only test of new DressingRoom wardrobe sections (costumes, trends, anime looks, Power Rangers/mecha cosplay, sneakers, wedges/mules/heels, gaming props, iconic hair) and rewritten generateOutfitPrompt. All 9 new section headers show exact counts (120/80/70/70/45/40/60/50/50); existing sections still render (Preset 81, Backgrounds 70, Gestures 30, Art Styles 61, Tops 134, Bottoms 118, Dresses 60, Dragonball 82, Villainess 30, Shoes 116, Hairstyles 48, Accessories 28, Positions 80). All 14 spot-check items present exactly once in their section; no duplicate items within or across new lists (node check). Pill select/deselect and single choice per section work. Prompt building verified with page.route mock of /api/dressing-room/generate (no real generation ran) after picking a Nexus Media Library base image: cases a-e all pass. Mobile 390: no horizontal overflow, new boxes are 120px with overflow-y auto and scroll. /dressing-room landing shows seo-intro/guide/faq; guide mentions 120 costumes, cosplay, sneakers, mules, hairstyles, props.

issues: Unselected pill text is quite dim against the dark glass background (pre-existing style, now applies to 585 more pills) - consider slightly brighter text color

action_items: Optional: add data-testid to wardrobe pills (e.g. wardrobe-{category}-{slug}) and section headers for robust testing; currently only preset costumes have testids
critical_code_review_comments: DressingRoom.jsx is 2409 lines - should be split (wardrobe section rendering, prompt builder, DeviantArt panel)
CATEGORY_LABELS object is recreated inside the map for every category on every render - hoist to module scope

selectedItems initial state does not include new extra category keys (works because undefined is falsy, but reset logic that relies on initial keys may not clear them - verify any 'clear selections' path)
Primary outfit precedence silently drops lower-priority full-look picks (e.g. Costume + Mecha => only Costume used) with no UI hint
seed_data_creation: None. Only a TEST_ custom prompt typed in UI; generate API was mocked so nothing persisted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pill selector pattern: xpath //div[contains(@class,'tsv-title') and starts-with(normalize-space(.),'<Label> (')]/following-sibling::div[1]//button[normalize-space(.)='<item>']. Base image via [data-testid=nexus-media-library-btn] then first [data-testid^=nexus-media-item-]. Mock generate with page.route('**/api/dressing-room/generate**').
